Platform & governance

Least-privilege keys

Per-key, per-model CRUD with field allowlists and domain filters — on top of Odoo ACLs and record rules, never instead of them. Scopes can only narrow access, never widen it.

Complete audit trail

Key, tool, payload, response and duration on every call — including exports and generated modules. Payload capture and retention are configurable.

Zero-downtime rotation

Several tokens live per key at once, so you rotate without a coordinated cutover. Old tokens keep working through a grace period (7 days by default), with notice 3 days out.

Rate limiting that scales

Per-second and per-minute caps shared across every worker via Redis, with per-key overrides for trusted service accounts. No Redis? It falls back to in-memory automatically.

Schema caching

Agents re-read model metadata constantly. Caching it shared across workers turns a ~50ms lookup into ~2ms, and it self-invalidates when models or permissions change.

Scales sideways

One worker or a hundred, single region or several. No sticky sessions and no shared local state, so you add workers without reconfiguring anything.

OAuth or API keys

One-click OAuth for Claude.ai, Cursor and other public clients — each teammate connects their own account. Or issue scoped API keys for servers and automation.

Managed from one menu

A dedicated MCP menu, not a Settings tab: keys, model access, audit logs, bulk jobs, generated modules, portal pages and OAuth clients in one place.

Everything Governed. Everything Visible.

Keys, per-model access, audit logs, bulk jobs, generated modules, portal pages and OAuth clients — every one of them in a dedicated MCP menu rather than buried in Settings. Here it is end to end, in one pass.

FAQ

Q: Does this bypass Odoo security?

A: No. Odoo ACLs, record rules, and groups still apply. Scopes only reduce what a key can access - they do not elevate permissions.

Q: Can I connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini?

A: You can connect any MCP-capable client/agent to your Odoo instance by pointing it to the /mcp endpoint and providing the API key token.

Q: Is this module AI inside Odoo?

A: No. This is a secure integration gateway (MCP server). AI runs externally and calls approved tools through Odoo governance.

Q: Can I rotate API keys safely without downtime?

A: Yes! The module supports zero-downtime token rotation with grace periods. Old tokens continue working for a configurable duration (default 7 days) while new tokens are deployed. Automatic notifications alert you 3 days before expiration.

Q: Will this work with multiple Odoo workers or load balancers?

A: Yes! The module uses Redis-backed distributed rate limiting and caching (with automatic fallback to in-memory if Redis is unavailable). Perfect for high-availability, multi-worker deployments. No shared state issues.

Q: How much faster will the API be with caching?

A: Schema caching provides 96% faster responses on cached requests (~2ms vs ~50ms). Overall API throughput improves 4x. Cache automatically invalidates when permissions change, so you always see current access rules.

Q: Do I need Redis for this to work?

A: No. Redis is optional. The module automatically falls back to in-memory caching and rate limiting if Redis is unavailable or disabled. Works perfectly fine without it, though Redis is recommended for high-scale deployments.

The KSRO AI Suite

Most Teams Don’t Stop Here.

The server you are installing is the foundation. Six department copilots run on top of it — same endpoint, same audit trail, same governance — each one fitted to your data and your approval flow when we deploy it with your team.

Accounting
Ledger Guard
Finds what your books are hiding — receipts that never matched, duplicate bills queued to pay twice, suspense nobody cleared. The AI writes a proposal, never a posting; a deterministic check re-runs it against Odoo’s accounting engine first.
Sales
Quote Pilot
Drafts quotations from a sentence, prices them off your real pricelists, and chases the ones that have gone quiet. Everything lands in draft for a human to confirm — nothing is sent behind your back.
CRM
Pipeline Sense
Scores open opportunities against what actually closed before, flags deals going cold, and tells each rep who to call today. Grounded in your own win history, not a generic lead score.
Helpdesk
Desk Pilot
Reads the ticket, pulls the matching history and drafts the reply, routing what it cannot answer. Agents approve in a click; customers get an answer in minutes instead of tomorrow.
Working Capital
Flow Guard
Cash sitting still is cash you cannot spend. Finds what will run out before the next delivery lands and what has not moved in a year, then drafts the replenishment that fixes both — against real supplier lead times and live demand, not a static reorder rule.
Leadership
MCP Insight
Curated dashboards for CEO, Sales, Finance and Operations, plus forecast, churn risk, anomaly review and receivables answered in plain language. Read-only board packs you can hand to the room.
Advanced Governance
Every switch stays in the admin’s hands.
One console decides what every single user’s AI may reach — before it reaches it. Nothing is inherited, nothing is assumed, and nothing changes without a record.
Set per person, not per company
Accounts reads invoices and nothing else. Sales drafts quotations but can never delete one.
Scope by app, not model by model
Point a policy at the Odoo apps a person works in; the rules underneath are written for you.
Hide what should stay hidden
Salary, margin, cost — block sensitive models and fields outright, from every AI, for everyone.
Switch off whole capabilities
Delete, archive, export, the module builder — off entirely, per policy, enforced on every call.
